surfaces.currentBehavior: Reads the reviewed conversion classification batches, product-decision traceability, architecture decisions, and manifest baseline; validates that every target-relevant surface below target_mapped has known blocker metadata while treating implemented, verified, rehearsed, and cutover-ready as mapped-or-later; groups exact affected surface IDs; and deterministically generates/checks the JSON and Markdown M2 residual queue without accessing Firebase, Supabase, PowerSync, credentials, or production data.
surfaces.notes: Operator-only coverage control. It does not resolve product decisions, change manifest target status, implement target behavior, or authorize production access.
